units.source_text: 我在寻找稻草的下落，因为刚才我将三相稻草到处乱塞，现在已经忘记塞在哪里。

en.t: I was looking for where the straw had gone, because a moment earlier I had stuffed the three bundles of straw here and there, and now I had forgotten where I had put them.

units.source_text: 待我找到的时候，火柴也已燃尽。

en.t: By the time I found them, the match had already burned out.

units.source_text: 我就地蹲了下来，这回是两根火柴一起划着的。

en.t: I crouched down on the spot; this time I struck two matches together.
